Specification: This module specifies a minimal one-variable boolean state machine. The variable x is initialized to TRUE and the next-state action flips its value with x' = ~x, and the main specification is Init /\ [][Next]_vars. The file also explores LET-defined operators and boxed action formulas by defining properties that pass temporal expressions such as [][x']_x0 and [][Next]_vars through local and top-level identity operators; it contains no fault model, no fairness assumptions, and no proofs.
